title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 14: compassion on Jacob, the taunt against the king of Babylon, the fall of the shining one, and words for Assyria and Philistia.

questions.text: On whom will Yahweh have compassion at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land.

questions.text: Against whom is the parable of verse 4 taken up?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon: "How the oppressor has ceased!"

questions.text: Which trees rejoice, saying no lumberjack has come up against them?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the cypress trees rejoice with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, "Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us."

answers.text: The olive trees and the fig trees
The cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon
The palm trees and the willows

questions.text: How is the fallen one addressed in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn!"

answers.text: Prince of the power of the air
Shining one, son of the dawn

questions.text: What did the king say in his heart he would make himself like?
questions.explanation: In verses 13-14 he said in his heart that he would ascend into heaven and make himself like the Most High.

questions.text: What question do those who see the fallen king ponder?
questions.explanation: Verses 16-17 say they will stare and ponder, asking, "Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms?"

answers.text: "Where are the gods of Babylon now?"
"Is this the man who made the earth to tremble?"
"How long will his city lie waste?"

questions.text: Yahweh says he will make Babylon a possession for which animal?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says, "I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water."

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh swear to break in his land and tread under foot on his mountains?
questions.explanation: Verses 24-25 record Yahweh's oath: "I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains."

questions.text: In which year did the burden against Philistia come?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says this burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.

answers.text: The year that king Uzziah died
The year that king Hezekiah died
The year that king Ahaz died

questions.text: What answer will be given to the messengers of the nation?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says the answer is that Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

answers.text: That the king of Assyria is coming
That the land will have rest for forty years
